The '''Cardio power system''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant that greatly increased the cardio-vascular recovery rate and pain tolerance of the wearer. This had the effect of granting what seemed to be almost supernatural stamina.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''KotOR'', the playable character must have the implant feat at level 3 to equip these items, whereas in ''KotOR II: TSL'', the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 16 or higher.
